unresolvedPublicationFindings.title: Polish B1 schema, runtime loading and reviewed alternative acceptance are not integrated
unresolvedPublicationFindings.evidence: The actual shared B1 schema rejects Polish/pl-PL on both exact reviewed files and rejects acceptedTargetAlternatives on all eight P1 learner turns. GuidedDialogueTurn has no such field. A source search found no acceptedTargetAlternatives/acceptedPhrases consumer in frontend/src or frontend/scripts. The actual Polish runtime export contains 100 A1 plus 100 A2 lessons and zero B1 lessons. The author scratch validator is self-review evidence, not an independently approved app gate or runtime path.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.impact: These sources cannot be published by the current shared shape, and accepting the authored opposite-gender strings has no proven typed, build or speech implementation. A structural scratch PASS does not establish that the learner can use them.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.requiredAction: Implement and independently review a true Polish/pl-PL B1 gate with only the specified learner-turn acceptedTargetAlternatives extension; preserve canonical text and all frozen A1/A2 data. Bind a current acceptance/integration artifact to the final sources, carry the eight complete manually authored alternatives into the intended surfaces without suffix generation, and verify the actual B1 renderer and unchanged 0.65 threshold/15-second scaffold before publication.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.verification: Exact final-source gate tests plus real rendered Polish B1 fixtures and canonical/opposite-gender typed and spoken checks. Do not reuse the pre-Fable source hashes or infer acceptance from the fuzzy canonical scorer.

unresolvedPublicationFindings.title: P1 L6 offers a grammatical alternative chip order that the current build check rejects

evidence.canonical: Gotowałam zupę, a tymczasem mój współlokator piekł chleb na kolację.
evidence.alternative: Gotowałam zupę, a tymczasem piekł chleb mój współlokator na kolację.
evidence.linguisticAssessment: The postposed subject gives marked information focus but remains grammatical Polish with the same two simultaneous activities, the same speakers and the same dinner purpose. No displayed spelling, punctuation or capitalisation is changed.

unresolvedPublicationFindings.impact: The learner can use every correct displayed chip to form a same-meaning sentence and still be marked wrong by exact string equality.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.requiredAction: Arbitrate and regroup the source chips, or explicitly implement reviewed build-order acceptance. A concrete four-chunk candidate is [Gotowałam zupę,] [a tymczasem mój współlokator] [piekł chleb] [na kolację.]; its longest chunk is four words and its join leaves canonical text unchanged. Review the corresponding bilingual chunk glosses. A speech-only alternative does not fix build scoring.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.verification: Exercise the current order and the reported alternative against the actual final build surface, or confirm the regrouped chips no longer offer that permutation. Recheck chunk counts/joins and any chunk-audio inventory after regrouping.

unresolvedPublicationFindings.title: Interlocutor turns still select the canonical learner gender outside the alternative mechanism

femaleP1: P1 L2 opener Co robiłaś po wyjściu z muzeum?
P1 L2 follow-up I kogo tam spotkałaś? Kogoś z pracy?
P1 L3 follow-up Ale pech! Jesteś cała mokra?
P1 L5 follow-up Zdążyłaś na pociąg? Drzwi były jeszcze otwarte?
P1 L8 opener Jak poznałaś nowego sąsiada?
maleP2: P2 L10 opener Podjąłeś już decyzję w sprawie naszego wyjazdu?
evidence.alternativeScope: The eight acceptedTargetAlternatives occur only on P1 dialogue[1]. Neither source metadata nor current renderer supplies paired interlocutor variants.

unresolvedPublicationFindings.impact: The canonical odd-female/even-male recording is coherent. However, presenting a male learner alternative in P1 while the interlocutor addresses a woman leaves the full conversation inconsistent; the same concern applies to exposing gender-free P2 to an unrestricted learner under its male-addressed opener.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.requiredAction: Before claiming gender-flexible lesson acceptance, explicitly resolve the interlocutor context: author gender-neutral interlocutor lines with all caption/base/audio dependencies reviewed, or provide a reviewed complete episode variant/clear role-play policy that explains the canonical role and alternative practice. Do not suffix-generate unreviewed interlocutor lines. This is not a request to change the current canonical TTS under this review.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.verification: Render and perform the whole four-turn episode in each supported alternative mode, including captions, interlocutor audio and learner scoring. Preserve the female P1/male P2 canonical voice plan unless separately amended.

evidence.target: Jednak późniejszy pociąg jest dogodniejszy, więc pojedziemy po południu.

unresolvedPublicationFindings.impact: The target refers to a train whose timing fits better. Günstiger gelegen normally describes a location and is an awkward rendering here; the Polish sentence and English meaning are sound.

mechanicalChecks.implementation: One-off in-memory Python checks written and executed by this reviewer; no source or validator files created.
checks: True Polish/pl-PL root identity and two ten-lesson paths
Bilingual nonempty de/en objects, NFC, no controls/replacement characters
Four turns, distinct opening/follow-up, learner word ranges
Four-to-seven chunks, each one-to-four spaced words, exact single-space join, distinct chips
Six-to-eight distinct terms, each attested at whole-word boundaries in a learner turn
Two cloze blanks per lesson, exact closing reconstruction, whole-word spans, four distinct choices with one canonical answer
Cue present iff form; cues are nonempty strings, not bilingual objects
Recall full reconstruction and whole-word content answer; four distinct choices
Exactly three distinct lowercase whole-word neutral speech tokens of at least four letters
Exact canonical whole-word trophy in first reply and example
Two/three pattern examples, target reuse and contiguous highlights
Verbatim quoted opening in both captions, no complete or four-word follow-up leakage
All eight whole-string alternatives: exact manually reviewed agreement pairs, same sentence count, unchanged trophy/speech/recall targets, full pattern example
No unnecessary alternative fields on gender-free turns
No digits or forbidden formal-register words in target surfaces
P1 range progression and P2 exact lesson-six przynajmniej production guard
mechanicalChecks.semanticBoundary: Assertions establish structure and exact couplings, not Polish naturalness, all possible valid chip permutations or choice uniqueness. The personal per-lesson read supplies the linguistic audit; its publication findings remain.

languageAudit.canonicalPolish: PASS for all bound canonical target text; no transliteration, digits, malformed gender forms or unlicensed register switch found.
languageAudit.gender: P1 has eight feminine first-turn targets and eight complete male alternatives. Explicit pairs include poszłam/poszedłem and wyszłam/wyszedłem; all twelve required word changes across the eight alternatives were independently compared. P1 closings and all P2 learner turns are speaker-gender-free. Third-person agreement remains fixed to its visible noun, including parasol, deszcz, rozmowa, siostra, pociąg, paczka, opakowanie and gość. No suffix-based alternative generation was used.
languageAudit.staging: P1 sequences/background in L1–3, podczas/zanim/tymczasem in L4–6, and wreszcie/akurat/okazało się/w sumie in L7–10 match the controlling specification. W sumie is never a trophy or cloze answer. P2 concession precedes contrasts, przynajmniej first appears productively at L6, and the conclusion markers begin in L7–10. No broad relaxation was inferred from the three-line clarification.
languageAudit.story: P1 has connected past stories, P2 responds to a new fact with an adjustment or qualified conclusion. Friend/colleague/flatmate roles remain coherent. Learners do not claim staff-only decisions. P1 L7 uses lavender as the actual new detail because the sweater is already named in the opener.
